**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require the cwd descriptor before accepting its name**

When `lsof` returns an incomplete stream such as `p101\nn/P\n` with exit 0 and empty stderr, this branch accepts `/P` even though no `fcwd` record established that the name belongs to the requested cwd descriptor; the computed `cwdDescriptor` flag is never enforced. `register()` consequently treats the identity as complete and grants owned/signal authority, contrary to V08's requirement that malformed or truncated probe formats remain failures. Require `descriptor` before accepting an `n` field, and cover the missing-descriptor case in the negative replay.
